subject: Important Update on Your Flight Booking
body: Dear valued customer, We regret to inform you that there has been a change in your upcoming flight schedule. Due to unforeseen circumstances, your flight departure time has been rescheduled to 2 hours earlier. We understand the inconvenience this may cause and apologize for any disruption to your travel plans. Please review the updated itinerary attached to this email for further details. Thank you for your understanding and cooperation. Safe travels.
